title: Thank You
body: Thank you for creating this app. Its so clean, and precisely done, and its free. The R79.00 is nothing and I soon will buy the premium. Other apps that want R2,000.00 per year do not come close to this apps UI/UX
author: CovertByte

title: Poor support
body:
Although the App is good, the support is pretty poor. 

Installed and tested the App, discovered that it only supports measurements in feet/inches and lbs, sent a messages to the developer enquiring about this and the silence is deafening!

Get real, the majority of the world’s population use the metric system - most apps provide an option to use the metric system!!!
author: FrancoisDMeyer

title: Super flexible, but challenging to navigate list
body: I love this app, but over time as my list of habits gets longer (and my dashboards get more complex), it gets very slow and the list gets very difficult to navigate. I have a few ideas on how to solve this. That said, it’s still the most flexible of the lot when it comes to tracking actual data. I really want to keep using this app and would love to help you improve it. I have a few ideas on how to solve the navigation issues. Drop me a message if you are interested in discussing it further.
author: vaugun

title: AMAZING APP! But…
body:
I love this app. It makes tracking habits easy and enjoyable.

But it has 2 serious problems:

(Update: both of the following problems are reported by the developer to be resolved in a future update - the developer feed back is great)

1. Why can't I check off a habit that is NOT a daily habit multiple times in a day? If I have a habit 6 days a week, and then I miss a day, I'd like to be able to check off that habit twice the next day in order to make up for missing the previous day! And why is the number of check-ins fixed? Why can't I check-in a 7th time if I happen to do a 6 day habit more than 6 times in a week?

2. Bugs. Swiping from side to side feels great but doesn't work very well. When I swipe horizontally, I have have to wait a second before I can swipe again otherwise the app won't recognize the second swipe. The app also frequently recognizes horizontal swipes as vertical swipes. And finally not being able to swipe horizontally when viewing the cards of a habit is extremely frustrating.
author: $Pete$

title: Nice
body: Nice, helpful app, just a bit one-dimensional, needs something more to add to the app. I forget to use it as it does such a small task, maybe add a new idea and dimension to the app.
author: Perks ;)

title: Really great intuitive app...
body: I use this app daily to track my habits - it's simple to use and easy to track. 3D Touch support makes it a simple matter of pressing the screen to mark habits as complete. Habits are easy to add and switch between too. If you forget to mark a day, simply swipe up to mark it on the calendar. Adding cards to your habit allows you to create custom milestones and see stats for your habits as well.
author: GavinBooyens

title: "Toady loves your Dukiness"
body:
"Do you like using Toady?" Flashed up on my screen and reminded me of Gummi Bears. 
Yes, I like it. It actually does help me develop habits. Everyday I practice guitar,  writing, get a minimum core done for work by minimising interruptions, get to the gym, smoke less, be nice to those I love and feel like I've achieved something at the end of a week, like I'm getting somewhere, like the rat race is less rat and more a journey of development.
